items.title: Jayden Higgins: Suffers torn ACL at practice
items.description:
Higgins was diagnosed Wednesday with an ACL tear, ruling him out for the 2026 season, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.description:

items.title: Tyler Biadasz: Out indefinitely with knee injury
items.description:
Biadasz is out indefinitely after suffering damage to his ACL and additional injuries to his left knee Tuesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers: Won't play in second preseason game
items.description:
Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said that Rodgers will be rested for Friday's preseason game against the Jets, Chris Adamski of TribLive.com reports.
